title: DR1's confirmation page tells a user who submitted an incomplete notification what they still have to do before the consignment is imported; the frontend has no such section.

finding.frontend: Below the reference panel the confirmation page shows the declaration date and then goes to 'Transporting the consignment', at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/template.njk:4-21. There is no outstanding-items section, and nothing in the confirmation copy or controller that could produce one. The frontend cannot produce one today either, because it will not let a notification be submitted at all until every task row is complete, so it has no idea of a submission with items left over.
finding.prototype: When the notification was submitted with things still outstanding, the page opens under the panel with 'Before the consignment is imported', the line 'You still need to:' and a list of what is left — in the capture, 'upload the health certificate and any other required documents' and 'complete the animal identifier information in the notification' (app/views/notification-submitted.html:27-37). The list is built at submission time from what the notification is missing.
finding.difference: This depends on the frontend first allowing an incomplete notification to be submitted, which is the review-page finding about reporting incompleteness on the page rather than blocking entry to it. Once that lands, the declaration handler needs to record which optional-at-submission items were left outstanding, and the confirmation page needs to render them under 'Before the consignment is imported' with 'You still need to:'. Until the submission rule changes there is nothing for this section to show, so it should be scheduled after that finding rather than alongside it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that DR1 renders this section on every submitted notification rather than only on an incomplete one, which would make it unconditional page furniture rather than a state the frontend cannot reach.

relatedTo.why: the frontend has to allow an incomplete submission before there is anything to list here
